models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Near-calm at Panarea tonight — 3 kt ESE, swell 0.2 ft; tomorrow stays light with an easterly filling in by afternoon.
briefing.synopsis: No organised gradient over the Aeolians: winds are running 2-4 kt and boxing the compass, with the consensus hourly set (every model with data at that hour) showing Panarea at 2.4 kt NNW at midday today and 3.7 kt NNW at 18:00. Overnight the flow backs into the SE quadrant — 3.2 kt at 114° at midnight, 3.6 kt at 133° at 06:00 Tuesday. Through Tuesday a light easterly builds, reaching 6.3 kt at midday and 8.3 kt ESE with gusts 13.4 kt by 18:00. ECMWF IFS and AIFS (both 04 Oct 18Z) and ICON-2i (05 Oct 00Z) are in step on this; the IFS gust field is an interval maximum, so gust-to-mean ratios look large in air this light.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: San Pietro buoy field is the recommendation for tonight at Panarea — 3.2 kt ESE, gusts 6.6 kt, swell 0.2 ft from the NNW, scored sheltered. San Pietro is open through 030-180°T and tonight's wind sits in that arc, but at 3 kt it is academic; Drautto and Cala Zimmari score essentially identically, so the choice does not matter. What would move the fleet is any ESE filling in harder than forecast overnight — the SE flow does arrive, it just arrives light, so a buoy check before turning in is enough.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Tuesday 6 Oct starts light at Panarea: 3.6 kt from 133° (SE) with gusts to 5.6 kt at 06:00, building only slowly to 6.3 kt SE by midday. If the fleet takes the optional Stromboli return leg, the payload gives a 06:00 departure as the recommended window — 4.1 kt SE, gusts 6.8 kt, 0.4 ft sea, beam reach, verdict go — with every window through 14:00 also marked go and nothing deteriorating later. Panarea tomorrow night stays sheltered at San Pietro, 6.6 kt SE, gusts 10.5 kt, swell 0.1 ft. Expect to motor or motorsail most of it.

passage_notes.note: Verdict go on every window. Recommended 06:00 departure: 2.9 kt NW, gusts 7.2 kt, 0.1 ft sea, close reach. By 14:00 up to 4.8 kt WNW, gusts 12.1 kt, 0.2 ft — a motoring passage.

Also go throughout. 06:00 start: 2.6 kt NNW, 0.1 ft. Berth at Marina del Gabbiano is flagged workable only — exposed through the full 360° and no anchoring; shelter there depends entirely on it staying calm, which tonight it does (2.8 kt N, gusts 6.4 kt, 0.3 ft swell).

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea (Tue 6 Oct, optional return, 11 nm, 219°T)
passage_notes.note: Go on all windows, 06:00 recommended. 4.1 kt SE at dawn rising to 6.5 kt ESE by 14:00, seas 0.3-0.4 ft, beam to broad reach.

Go throughout; 4-6 kt SSE/ESE, 0.7 ft sea, broad reach turning to a run in the afternoon. Note the models split at Panarea midday Wednesday — the range is 1.9 to 8.7 kt, and 3.5 to 9.9 kt at 18:00, so treat the means as soft.
Go, but 3-5 kt SSE backing ESE puts the true wind angle at 19-28° from 10:00 on — head to wind, so it is a motor unless you leave at 06:00 (4.7 kt SSE, 76° TWA). Seas 0.5-0.6 ft.

The one leg with real wind: 10.6 kt W at 06:00 building to 14.1 kt W with gusts 20.4 kt by afternoon, broad reach, 0.9-1.0 ft. The 08:00 window is scored no-go on forecast thunderstorms; windows either side are go. Portorosa Marina is enclosed, all-round shelter, but shows 10.2 kt WSW gusting 26.8 kt on arrival day.

cautions: Salina → Portorosa on Fri 9 Oct: thunderstorms are forecast in the 08:00-12:00 window, which is scored no-go. The payload also flags deterioration after 07:00. Still five days out — we will re-run it.
Portorosa Marina on 9 Oct shows gusts to 26.8 kt against a 10.2 kt mean — plan the berthing approach and line handling accordingly.
Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli is exposed through all 360° with no anchoring permitted; it only works while it stays calm.

Model spread at Panarea, Stromboli, Filicudi and Salina on Wed 7 Oct (ranges of 1.9-8.7 kt, 2.7-10.1 kt, 1.7-10.4 kt and 2.2-10.5 kt at the flagged hours) — do not plan Wednesday afternoon sailing on the mean.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i agree closely on tonight and tomorrow, and run-to-run stability over the last 23 snapshots shows mean wind shifts of only 0.4-0.6 kt out to 24 h; confidence drops for Friday's Portorosa leg, where spread widens to 5.8 kt at 72-120 h.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
